Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists major 
maintenance procedure P2, which must be performed every 
six 
years as 
indicated by Y6 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Gamal Soliman, tested by eng. Galal Kamel 
Salem at 16 Nov.03, accepted by general director eng. Reda Mohamed Ahmed Al_Roos at Assuit 
500kv substation, and approved by Middle Egypt Zone Quality Control general 
director eng. Ahmed Saied Abel Azez.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
CB must be fully isolated, 
and ensure it is properly grounded.
Turn 
off the control circuit "DC" power supply.
Exhaust 
operation compressed air.
Take care of 
flanges and gasket.
Don't allow to 
dust to adhere to
flanges and gaskets.
Don't dismantle the shaft seal.
Don't dismantle the gas density.
Don't expose absorbent to open air.
Confirm that O2
 % concentration exceed 18% before starting inside checking
Confirm tighten of bolts and nuts, those removed then mark tightens.
Tools and Equipment
Gas 
 detector, Air blower, SF6 gas detector
Safety helmet, safety shoes .... etc,
Work to be Carried Out
Check the 
 stationary arcing contact through looking at inspection window.
Replace the 
 contact if the wear more than 3 mm.
Apply thin 
 coat of grease.
Remove the 
 moving contact.
Measure the 
 inner diameter.
Replace if 
 wear more then 2 mm.
Apply thin 
 coat of grease.
Clean both 
 insulation nozzle and cover.
Measure the 
 inner diameter of them, replace if 
 the wear 1 mm
Change absorbent with 
 a new one quickly just before vacuum.
Remove 
 operating cylinder cover then inspect gaskets,
Apply grease 
 to piston guide main value and operating piston.
Supply new 
 oil to the piston of oil plug.
Check pins 
 links levers.
Check nuts 
 for possible loosen.
Apply then 
 layer of grease.
Closing Link Mechanism
Clean up 
 hook pins and roller.
Check state 
 of hook engagement.
Apply them 
 layer of grease.
Electro Magnetic Valve
Clean up and 
 apply a turbine oil to hook.
Check nuts 
 bolts and split pins.
Airing Value
Connect a 
 hose to the discharge of port.
Measure 
 discharge using measuring cylinder ( 300 - 700 ) cc/min.
Auxiliary Switch
Check 
 contacts.
Check 
 terminal for tightening.
Apply thin 
 coat of grease to pin.
Pressure Gauge
Calibrate 
 the gauge using standard one.
Don't allow 
 ingress or dust into pressure gauge.
Pressure Switch
Check the 
 pressure setting.
Anti-Pumping Contact
Check 
 contacts, repair if needed.
Operation tests
Carry out 
 timing test.
Carry out DC 
 resistance test.
SF6 Gas Test
Check sealed 
 parts for SF6 gas leak
Carry out dew 
 point test
Carry out 
 SF6 purity test
Carry out 
 SO2 content test
Carry out 
 SF6 decomposition product test
